_comment: Standards-Based Laboratory Compliance Check rules. Deterministic, not AI. Each parameter limit can depend on the honey category. 'notRecorded' lists parameters the standard sets but the HoneyChain lab form cannot record; they are reported, never assumed to pass.

categories.BLOSSOM: Blossom / nectar honey (any honey not listed separately)
categories.BLEND_HONEYDEW_BLOSSOM: Blend of honeydew honey and blossom honey
categories.CITRUS_ROBINIA_ALFALFA: Citrus, false acacia (Robinia), alfalfa and other Codex 10 g/100 g sucrose sources
categories.TROPICAL_ORIGIN: Honey of declared origin from a country or region with a tropical ambient temperature

FSSAI.name: FSSAI honey standard
FSSAI.reference: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 2.8.3(1)(V) Honey, as amended
FSSAI.verification: Limits and honey-type exceptions checked against the text of FSSAI Chapter 2.8 (fssai.gov.in) on 2026-11-23.

parameters.label: Moisture
parameters.failAdvice: High moisture allows fermentation; check for unripe honey or added water.

parameters.label: Fructose + glucose (total reducing sugars)
parameters.note: FSSAI sets a minimum for total reducing sugars; HoneyChain records fructose and glucose and uses their sum.
parameters.failAdvice: Low reducing sugars can indicate dilution or syrup addition; consider confirmatory sugar profiling.

parameters.label: Sucrose
parameters.failAdvice: High sucrose can indicate sugar feeding or adulteration with sucrose syrup.

parameters.label: Fructose / glucose ratio
parameters.failAdvice: An F/G ratio outside the permitted range can indicate syrup addition; consider isotope (C4/C3) testing.

parameters.label: Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF)
parameters.failAdvice: High HMF indicates heating or long/poor storage.

parameters.label: Electrical conductivity

BLEND_HONEYDEW_BLOSSOM.notApplicable: FSSAI states a maximum for honeys not listed under honeydew and a minimum for honeydew honey; no limit is stated for blends.

parameters.failAdvice: Conductivity outside the range for the declared category can indicate a wrong botanical declaration.

notRecorded.label: Carbon isotope differences (delta 13C)
notRecorded.limit: max +/-2.1 permil; fructose-glucose +/-1.0 permil; protein-honey >= -1.0 permil

CODEX.name: Codex Alimentarius honey standard
CODEX.reference: Codex Standard for Honey, CXS 12-1981 (Rev. 1 1987, Rev. 2 2001)
CODEX.verification: Values as previously configured in HoneyChain from CXS 12-1981 Rev. 2; the source text could not be re-fetched during this update.

parameters.label: Fructose + glucose
parameters.failAdvice: Low fructose + glucose can indicate dilution or syrup addition.

parameters.label: Sucrose
parameters.failAdvice: High sucrose can indicate sugar feeding or adulteration.

parameters.label: Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF)
parameters.failAdvice: High HMF indicates heating or long storage.

parameters.label: Electrical conductivity

BLEND_HONEYDEW_BLOSSOM.notApplicable: Codex limits apply to blossom honeys and to honeydew/chestnut honeys; a blend of honeydew and blossom honey needs analyst judgement.

parameters.failAdvice: Conductivity outside the range for the declared category can indicate a wrong botanical declaration.

notRecorded.label: Diastase activity
notRecorded.limit: >= 8 Schade units (>= 3 for low-enzyme honey with HMF <= 15 mg/kg)
